meta_description:
lakshmisharath on September 21, 2026: "Devprayag is where the Ganga gets her name—at the sacred sangam where the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi meet and flow onwards as one river. It is also one of Uttarakhand’s five sacred Panch Prayags.

SAVE THIS MINI TRAVEL GUIDE

📍 Places to visit
• Devprayag Sangam and the ghats
• Gangeshwar Mahadev Temple beside the sangam
• Raghunathji Temple, dedicated to Lord Rama
• The bridges and viewpoints overlooking the confluence

🚗 How to reach
Devprayag is around 70–75 km from Rishikesh and takes approximately three hours by road. Shared taxis and buses are also available.

🗓️ Best time to visit
March to May and October to November. Avoid the peak monsoon months, when landslides and road disruptions are possible.

⏳ Time required
Allow two to three hours. Stay overnight if you would like to experience the town and sangam at a slower pace.

🏡 Where to stay
Devprayag has simple guesthouses and homestays. Rishikesh and Srinagar offer more accommodation options.

Save this Devprayag travel guide for your Uttarakhand journey.

India, one story at a time.

#Devprayag #Uttarakhand #Ganga #Indiaonestoryatatime #templesofindia".
